title: Listening Drill — Preparing a bird feeder
description: Practical demonstration. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Preparing a bird feeder
sections.transcript:
INSTRUCTOR: This demonstration is about preparing a bird feeder. Watch the whole process once before trying it yourself. If you start while I'm still talking, you may miss the order of the steps.

INSTRUCTOR: Get the seed mix ready. Begin by checking the hanger. When everything is in position, wait five minutes. It may look as though nothing is happening at first.

INSTRUCTOR: Look for a balanced feeder before moving on. clean the work surface afterwards. Leave yourself time to clear the work area so the next group can start promptly.
